about: The choices [JEngine] leaves open, searched rather than fixed. Scored against the same tables as the literal board, by a rule with no threshold to ratchet: at or under the printed value in every cell. Nothing here is read by the literal board, and nothing in literal.json is read here. The candidates are plan/search.py's: one plan per cell, recorded per (L, n_batches) in searched_cuts.json so a replay does not re-search. Since #172 each plan is a cut whose largest batch is within one target of the cell's minimax, plus one explicit seed-order permutation per batch, climbed from the 58 seed_orders(widened=True) rules over a bounded neighbourhood. The plan scored is selected from the Pareto frontier over (max intermediates, FLOPs) by #171's selection rule, which was declared before the board was read (searched_cuts.json's 'objective' quotes it). A climbed order is a choice this board makes, not a recovered input of the paper's. at_or_under reports each cell's margin over the printed value and never judges it. Since #172 no cell is over; data/literature/jengine/limits.json's searched record names the space searched and keeps the earlier spaces' residual as previous_residual.
